violations.description: Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device in walk-in-cooler was not accurate. Repair to working order.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface Microwave out in front was not cleaned as frequently as required.--Nonfood contact surface under fountain machine cabinet was not cleaned as frequently as required. Water needs to be removed.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Need to remove brooms away from front of sink.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory * was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels needed for drying hands.
